content: One single heartfelt sigh from an oppressed soul can shake the foundations of heaven.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: Tyrants and cruel managers may believe their legal contracts and corporate power insulate them from consequence. But the silent, weeping sigh of a worker who has been cheated or humiliated vibrates through the cosmic fabric of justice. Treat people with holy care.
practicalInsight: Pay your debts promptly and treat service workers with lavish fairness today. Never let an unpaid grievance linger.
reflectionPrompt: Have your actions or harsh management ever drawn a weary sigh of injury from someone under your authority?
